name: slack-bridge
description: Bidirectional Slack channel connector (Socket Mode — no public URL required). Inbound channel messages land in the lead's inbox; the lead replies via the slack.send MCP tool.

includeBotMessages.title: Include bot messages
includeBotMessages.description: Forward messages posted by other bots/apps (default: drop them to avoid loops).

botToken.title: Bot Token
botToken.description: xoxb-… token with chat:write + the channel read scopes.

channel.title: Channel ID
channel.description: Slack channel id (e.g. C0123ABCD) the lead converses in.
